_schema.kind: rule = lasts the whole pub | challenge = one-off at that pub | forfeit = punishment for getting caught
_schema.cat: drinking | talking | social | dares | physical | brain | silly
_schema.group: true = whole group, false = one random person
_schema.when: challenges only: arrival | drop (surprise, 10-20 min in)
_schema.pick: rule needs one person picked (label shown)

items.text: Left hand only. Drink with your right and you're caught.
Five-minute pub. Everyone finishes their drink within 5 minutes of it landing on the table. Halves allowed.
Thumb master. When they put a thumb on the table, everyone copies. Last one takes a forfeit.
Sip word. The group picks a common word. Every time anyone says it, everyone sips.
No drinking unless someone toasts first. Sip without a toast and you're caught.
Hand on your head every time you sip.
The Boss. One person is picked as Boss. Ask their permission before every sip.
Glass down = glass empty. If your glass touches the table, you finish it next time you pick it up.
Waterfall. The person who picks starts drinking, everyone follows, and nobody stops until the person before them does.
Order something you've never had before.
Someone else orders for you. No complaints.
Fastest finisher picks everyone's next drink.
No swearing.
No first names. Use 'boss', 'chief' or a nickname.
Don't say 'drink', 'pint', 'beer' or 'pub'.
No saying 'yes' or 'no'.
Third person only. 'Harry would like a pint.'
Accent pub. The group picks one accent and everyone keeps it all pub.
Every sentence ends with 'lad'.
Questions only. Every sentence has to be a question.
Rhyming pub. Each sentence must rhyme with the one before it.
Opposite pub. Say the opposite of what you mean.
Word ban. The group bans 'the'. Good luck.
Silent ordering. Order without saying the name of what you want.
No English for the first 10 minutes. Any other language, or none.
Phones off the table. Photos only.
Phones away completely, photos included.
Seat swap. Nobody sits beside the person they sat beside last pub.
Standing pub. Nobody sits down.
No pointing. Elbows only.
Swap one item of clothing with the person on your right, and keep it for the next two pubs.
Maths toll. Before each sip, answer a sum set by the person on your left.
Fizz buzz. Count round the table: 'fizz' for multiples of 3, 'buzz' for 5. Mess up, forfeit.
Everyone gets a new nickname at the door. Old names are banned.
T-Rex arms. Elbows stay tucked to your sides all pub.
Compliment sandwich. Every complaint has to be wrapped in two compliments.
Cheers in a different language every time you clink. No repeats all pub.
Big up the bar staff. Every order ends with a genuine compliment.
Pirate pub. Every sentence starts with 'Arr'.
Sports commentator pub. Narrate whatever you're doing as you do it.
No saying 'I' or 'me'. Find a way round it.
Posh pub. Everyone talks like they're at a garden party.
No talking about work, college or exams. Mention it and you're caught.
Hashtag pub. End every sentence with a hashtag. Out loud.
Robot pub. Talk like a robot and say 'beep' at the end of every sentence.
Swap names with the person opposite you for the whole pub.
County accents. Everyone picks a different Irish county and keeps its accent all pub.
Toast master. Nobody sips until the toast master has toasted them by name.
Every sentence has to include a colour.
Alphabet pub. Each sentence starts with the next letter of the alphabet, round the table.
No words starting with 'S'. Good luck saying anything.
Yoda pub. Backwards, every sentence must be.
Two hands on the glass. Always.
Pinkie out every time you sip.
Glass lives on a beer mat. Off the mat and you're caught.
Water with everything. Every drink ordered here comes with a glass of water.
Eye contact for every cheers. Look away and you're caught.
Say 'Sláinte' before every sip. Forget and you're caught.
No touching your own glass. Someone else has to hand it to you.
Copycat pub. You can only sip when the leader sips.
Linked arms. Every sip happens arm-in-arm with someone.
Clink before every sip. Find someone to clink with or wait.
Before your first sip, ask someone a question you've never asked them before.
High fives all round for anyone coming back from the bar.
Positive vibes only. No moaning about anything. At all.
Musical chairs. Every time someone goes to the bar, everyone shifts one seat left.
One person goes to the bar per round and carries everything back.
Introduce yourself formally every time you come back to the table.
No checking the time. Ask someone and say please.
Phones face down in the middle. First to touch theirs buys the crisps.
Jacket on inside out for the whole pub.
The group picks your opinion on everything for this pub. No disagreeing.
Rhyme your order. Every drink order is a rhyming couplet.
Category pub. Pick a category (like Irish counties). Before each sip, name a new one. Repeat or freeze and you're caught.
Spell it. Spell your drink out loud before ordering.
Name that tune. When a song starts, first to name it picks someone for a forfeit. Guess wrong and it's you.
Every question has to be answered with a number. Any number.
Salute every time someone says 'pint'.
Clap twice before you sit down.
Thumbs up to the bar staff every time you get served.
Duck walk to the bar and back.
Everyone stands up whenever anyone says 'lads'.
Dramatic gasps. Gasp loudly every time someone says the group's chosen word.
Hat pub. Make a hat out of whatever you can find and wear it all pub.
Slow-mo. When someone shouts 'action', everyone moves in slow motion for 10 seconds.
Mime pub. For the first 10 minutes nobody talks. Mime everything, ordering included.
Stand up to tell any story.
Sit on your hands whenever you're not holding your drink.
Every time someone says 'Christmas', everyone does a squat.
Wall pub. You can only sip with your back against a wall.
Rock paper scissors tournament. Loser finishes their drink.
Race the person opposite you to finish your drinks. Loser buys the next round of crisps.
Group shot. Everyone picks one shot of their choice. Toast to the halfway point.
Blind taste test. Someone orders three drinks; guess which is which.
Round of something local: a stout, a cider or an Irish whiskey. Soft drinks count.
Random victim chugs whatever's left of their drink. No halves.
Never have I ever, five rounds. Sip if you have.
Most likely to. Count to three and point. Most fingers on you means a big sip.
Get a group photo with the bar staff.
Find out a stranger's favourite pub in town and tell the group.
Get another group to toast with you.
Get a stranger to tell you an embarrassing story before you leave.
Everyone tells a story the rest of the group has never heard.
Everyone names their favourite pub so far and defends it.
The group writes a text. You send it to someone of their choosing.
Order your drink in the worst accent you can do.
Ask the bar staff for their honest rating of your outfit.
Give a 30-second toast to the whole pub. Volume required.
Get a stranger to sign your arm with a pen.
Post the worst photo of yourself from tonight to your story.
Group picks your Instagram story caption for the next hour.
Request a song from the bar staff. If there's a band, request one from them.
Arm wrestle tournament. Champion picks the next rule victim.
Walk to the next pub in a conga line.
Piggyback someone at least halfway to the next pub.
Coin flip game. Land a coin in an empty glass. Last to do it takes a forfeit.
Pub quiz. Each person asks one question; the group keeps score.
Guess the bill. Closest guess to the round's total wins; furthest buys the crisps.
Name a country for each letter of the alphabet, round the table. Freeze and you're out.
Mental maths speed round. Loser of three sums finishes their drink.
Everyone writes a fake fact about themselves. Guess whose is whose.
Recreate an old photo of the group, as accurately as possible.
Staring contest bracket. Champion gets a free pass on the next forfeit.
Everyone describes the person to their left in exactly three words.
Two truths and a lie, round the table.
Everyone shares the best thing that happened to them this year.
Toast to someone who isn't here tonight.
Everyone says what their autobiography would be called.
Guess everyone's go-to order. Most right wins.
Would you rather, round the table. Everyone asks one.
Explain a film badly. The group guesses which one.
Name all 32 counties as a group in two minutes.
Rank the pubs so far. The whole group has to agree.
Group photo where everyone pulls their worst face.
Invent a team name for tonight. Best one wins.
Make up a group handshake. Use it all pub.
Everyone does an impression of the person on their right.
Thumb war tournament. The champion picks the next person for a forfeit.
Beer mat flip. Flip one off the table edge and catch it. Last to do it takes a forfeit.
Plank-off. Last one holding wins; first to drop takes a forfeit.
Everyone orders the drink the person on their left would least expect. Soft drinks count.
Rock paper scissors, round the table. The champion is immune to the next forfeit.
Hot seat. Two minutes, the group can ask you anything.
Order the round using only a made-up language and pointing.
Pick the music. Ask the bar staff nicely if they'll play one song.
Everyone texts someone they haven't spoken to in ages: 'Thinking of you, happy Christmas!'
Everyone shares their best moment of the night so far.
Everyone does a 30-second wall sit. Right now.
Arm wrestle the person opposite. Losers fetch a round of waters.
Conga to the bar and back. Everyone.
Freeze! Everyone holds their exact pose for 30 seconds. First to move takes a forfeit.
Staring contest with the person opposite. Losers buy the crisps.
Everyone swaps one item (hat, scarf, jacket) with the person on their left until the next pub.
Quickfire Christmas songs. Name one each, round the table. Freeze and you're out.
Quickfire capitals. Someone names a country, the next person names its capital. Freeze and you're out.
Water round. Everyone gets a glass of water and finishes it before anything else.
Swap drinks with the person on your right for one sip.
The person with the most forfeits picks everyone's next drink. Soft drinks count.
Get a stranger to teach you a dance move. Then show the group.
Ask the bar staff to recommend your next drink, and order it.
Lead the whole table in a song. At least one full verse.
Find someone in the pub with the same birthday month as you.
Get a stranger to guess your job. Keep going until they get it.
Call a parent on speaker and tell them you love them.
Get three strangers to tell you their favourite crisps.
Give a stranger a genuine compliment on their outfit.
Say the alphabet backwards. Get it wrong and take a forfeit.
Give a 30-second wedding speech for two people at the table.
Big sip.
Finish your drink.
Take a shot. Group picks it.
Drink from someone else's glass. They choose how much.
Buy the next round of shots or crisps. Your choice, the group decides how many.
Group orders your next drink. No vetoes.
10 squats, right now.
20 push-ups on the pub floor.
Carry everyone's coats to the next pub.
Compliment everyone at the table, one by one.
Text your mam 'I love you' and read out the reply.
Text your ex 'thinking of you'. Or a full drink instead.
Group gets your phone for 60 seconds. Anything but messages.
Call someone and sing them happy birthday. It doesn't have to be their birthday.
Wear the tinsel until the next pub.
Do an impression of someone in the group. They pick who.
Whisper only until the next pub.
Speak in a pirate voice until your next forfeit.
Sing the opening line of a Christmas song. Loudly.
Stand on your chair and announce your crimes to the pub.
Tell your most embarrassing story. The group judges if it counts.
The group writes your next Instagram story. It stays up 24 hours.
Name 10 pubs in this town in 30 seconds or take a big sip.
Wear a napkin hat until the next pub.
Talk in rhymes until your next sip.
Say something nice about every pub so far.
Build a five-high beer mat tower before your next sip.
Ten seconds of your best robot dance.
Speak in the third person until the next pub.
Be the group's butler for the next round. Fetch, carry, and say 'certainly'.
Runway walk to the bar and back.
Take your next three sips through a straw.
15 star jumps.
Drink a full glass of water before your next drink.
Hold a plank for 30 seconds.
Lunge your way to the bar.
Buy a round of waters for the table.
Give the group a 30-second motivational speech.
Tell the table a joke. Nobody laughs, tell another.
Send a voice note to the family group chat singing Jingle Bells.
Ring a friend and tell them a terrible joke. They have to laugh.
Sing the chorus of your most-played song this year.
Post 'I love 12 Pubs' to your story with no context.
The group picks your profile picture for 24 hours.
Let the group read your last three searches out loud.
Give a stranger a genuine compliment.
Ask the bar staff to rate your dancing out of 10. Then dance.
Serenade someone at the table. The group picks the song.
Twenty-second interpretive dance about your day.
Swap an item of clothing with whoever the group picks, until the next pub.
Name five Irish counties in five seconds.
Name every pub so far, in order.
Spell the name of this pub backwards.
Alphabet backwards in 30 seconds.
Your next drink is a half.
Your next drink is the group's choice. Soft drinks count.
Next round's on you. The group decides how big.
Everyone has a water or soft drink before anything else.
Chips, a toastie, anything. Nobody skips.
All rules lifted. Toast whoever made it.
